Name: EvolvingAIConversation
Author: kuanglang1234
Description:
[b]English[/b]
[b]Evolving AI Conversation — v2.3.3[/b]
Have free-form conversations with Stardew Valley NPCs. They remember shared experiences, form impressions of you and other characters, and respond through their own personalities, relationships and feelings. Long-term personality growth is presented as proposals for you to review and approve.
[b]Main features:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Memory and personality growth:[/b] conversations and experiences shape later interactions, with reflection, editable memories and profile history.[/*]
[*][b]Text, voice and attachments:[/b] type messages, send recordings, images or documents, and hear replies with individual NPC voices.[/*]
[*][b]Letters and gifts:[/b] NPCs can write daily letters or follow-ups and choose gifts to include.[/*]
[*][b]Group conversations:[/b] chat with several NPCs, each with their own perspective and impressions of the others.[/*]
[*][b]Dates and following:[/b] invite NPCs on solo or group dates, receive visits, or ask them to accompany you.[/*]
[*][b]Autonomous Life:[/b] enable characters to choose work, hobbies, rest and social activities using their profiles, needs and relationships.[/*]
[*][b]Feelings and calibration:[/b] optionally track body needs, emotions and feelings toward the player. Review AI calibration suggestions or edit values yourself.[/*]
[*][b]Public events:[/b] select several NPCs, write a shared event and add individual perspectives. Each receives their own shallow memory.[/*]
[*][b]Phone experience exchange:[/b] export a character package to the companion website and import experiences back into the same game save.[/*]
[*][b]Media generation:[/b] configure separate services for images, speech and music.[/*]
[*][b]Streaming and manual retry:[/b] receive supported API responses incrementally, then display them after completion and validation. Failed requests preserve your input for editing or retry.[/*]
[*][b]Optional conversation time:[/b] successful player rounds can account for five game minutes and advance feelings accordingly.[/*]
[*][b]In-game management:[/b] use F7 to manage profiles, memories, impressions and permissions, and F8 to browse character feelings.[/*]
[/list][b]Getting started:[/b]
Install the mod in your SMAPI Mods folder. Open [b]AI Settings[/b], configure your dialogue API and key, and enable the NPCs you want to talk to. Face an NPC and press [b]Q[/b] for text conversation or [b]V[/b] for phone mode. Use [b]G[/b] for group conversations and [b]H[/b] for date invitations.
Spoken replies require a configured speech-generation service. Player recordings require a dialogue model that supports audio input; other attachments also need compatible models. Feelings, Autonomous Life and adult physiology have separate optional controls. Streaming reception does not currently display replies word by word.

中文
[b]中文[/b]
[b]Evolving AI Conversation — v2.3.3[/b]
和《星露谷物语》的 NPC 自由交流。他们会记住共同经历，形成对你和其他角色的印象，并结合各自的人格、关系与感受作出回应。长期人格成长会以提案形式交给你查看和确认。
[b]主要功能：[/b]
[list]
[*]**记忆与人格成长：**对话和经历影响之后的互动，支持反思、记忆编辑与人格版本记录。[/*]
[*]**文字、语音与附件：**支持打字、发送录音、图片和文档，以及使用 NPC 专属音色朗读回复。[/*]
[*]**信件与礼物：**NPC 可以写日常来信或续信，并选择随信附带的礼物。[/*]
[*]**多人对话：**和多位 NPC 一起聊天，每人保留自己的视角，并形成对彼此的印象。[/*]
[*]**约会与跟随：**邀请单人或多人约会、接待来访，或请 NPC 陪你一起行动。[/*]
[*]**自主生活：**开启后，角色会结合人格、需求和关系选择工作、兴趣、休息与社交活动。[/*]
[*]**感受与校准：**可选开启身体需求、持续情绪和对玩家感受，预览 AI 校准建议，也可直接手动修改数值。[/*]
[*]**公共事件：**选择多位 NPC，填写共同经历并补充各自视角，分别写入每人的浅层记忆。[/*]
[*]**手机经历互通：**导出角色包到配套网页继续交流，再把经历导回同一个游戏存档。[/*]
[*]**媒体生成：**可分别配置图片、语音和音乐生成服务。[/*]
[*]**流式接收与手动重试：**支持逐段接收接口响应，完整校验后显示；失败时保留输入，方便修改或重试。[/*]
[*]**可选聊天计时：**成功完成的玩家交流可计入 5 个游戏分钟，并同步推进感受变化。[/*]
[*]**游戏内管理：**通过 F7 管理人格、记忆、印象和权限，通过 F8 浏览角色感受状态。[/*]
[/list][b]开始使用：[/b]
将 Mod 安装到 SMAPI 的 Mods 文件夹。在 **“AI 设置”**中配置对话接口与 API 密钥，并启用想交流的 NPC。面对 NPC，按 [b]Q[/b] 进行文字交流，按 [b]V[/b] 使用电话模式；按 [b]G[/b] 开始多人对话，按 [b]H[/b] 发起约会邀请。
朗读回复需要配置语音生成服务；发送玩家录音需要支持音频输入的对话模型，其他附件也需要相应模型支持。感受、自主生活和成人生理模块可分别控制。当前流式功能是网络接收方式，聊天框仍在回复完整后显示内容。

Q群 二9一9零9六2九 更新更快
